sortid.title: Sort id
sortid.description: Render order. Defaults to highest existing + 10.

force.title: Force
force.description: Forces the label to always be drawn even if it would overlap other labels/features. Maps to MapServer LABEL FORCE.

minscaledenom.title: Min scale denominator
minscaledenom.description: Minimum scale denominator at which this label is drawn. Maps to MapServer LABEL MINSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

maxscaledenom.title: Max scale denominator
maxscaledenom.description: Maximum scale denominator at which this label is drawn. Maps to MapServer LABEL MAXSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

position.title: Position
position.description: Label placement relative to its anchor point: auto, or a combination of upper/center/lower and left/center/right (e.g. 'ul' = upper-left, 'cc' = centered on the point). Maps to MapServer LABEL POSITION.

size.title: Size
size.description: Label font size in pixels; may reference a numeric attribute as [column]. Maps to MapServer LABEL SIZE. Defaults to 11 when empty. Numeric value stored as a string.

color.title: Color
color.description: Label text color. Maps to MapServer LABEL COLOR. Defaults to black when empty.

outlinecolor.title: Outline color
outlinecolor.description: Halo/outline color drawn around the label text to improve legibility. Maps to MapServer LABEL OUTLINECOLOR. Defaults to white when empty.

buffer.title: Buffer
buffer.description: Minimum distance, in pixels, kept clear around the label so it does not crowd other labels. Maps to MapServer LABEL BUFFER. Numeric value stored as a string.

repeatdistance.title: Repeat distance
repeatdistance.description: Distance, in pixels, at which the label is repeated along a line feature. Maps to MapServer LABEL REPEATDISTANCE. Numeric value stored as a string.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Rotation angle of the label text in degrees, or one of the keywords 'auto', 'auto2' or 'follow' for automatic orientation along the feature. May also reference a [column]. Maps to MapServer LABEL ANGLE.

backgroundcolor.title: Background
backgroundcolor.description: Fill color of a rectangle drawn behind the label text, rendered as a MapServer STYLE with GEOMTRANSFORM 'labelpoly' nested inside the LABEL. Empty disables the background.

backgroundpadding.title: Padding
backgroundpadding.description: Padding, in pixels, around the label text; used as the WIDTH of the background rectangle style when backgroundcolor is set. Defaults to 1. Numeric value stored as a string.

offsetx.title: Offset X
offsetx.description: Horizontal pixel offset applied to the label position. Maps to the X component of MapServer LABEL OFFSET. Numeric value stored as a string.

offsety.title: Offset Y
offsety.description: Vertical pixel offset applied to the label position. Maps to the Y component of MapServer LABEL OFFSET. Numeric value stored as a string.

font.title: Font
font.description: Base font family name, combined with fontweight to resolve a FONTSET alias defined in the server's fonts.txt (e.g. 'arial' + 'bold' -> 'arialbold'). Available families depend on server configuration; 'arial' and 'courier' are provided out of the box. Contributes to MapServer LABEL FONT.

fontweight.title: Font weight
fontweight.description: Font weight/style, appended to font to select the concrete FONTSET alias. Contributes to MapServer LABEL FONT.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: MapServer LABEL-level EXPRESSION; when set, this label entry is only rendered for features matching the expression.

maxsize.title: Max size
maxsize.description: Maximum font size, in pixels, used when scaling text. Maps to MapServer LABEL MAXSIZE. Defaults to 256. Numeric value stored as a string.

minfeaturesize.title: Min feature size
minfeaturesize.description: Minimum size, in pixels, a feature must have to be labeled (line length for lines, smallest bounding-box dimension for polygons); the keyword 'auto' labels only features larger than their own rendered label. Maps to MapServer LABEL MINFEATURESIZE.

properties.description: Layer properties (the def JSON). All values are stored as strings (empty string when unset), except where noted.

theme_column.title: Class item
theme_column.description: Column (attribute) evaluated against each class's expression. Maps to MapServer LAYER CLASSITEM. Empty means classes are matched without a CLASSITEM (e.g. numeric/logical expressions only).

label_column.title: Label item
label_column.description: Column whose value is exposed to legacy label text/expressions. Maps to MapServer LAYER LABELITEM.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Layer opacity percentage (0-100), applied via a MapServer LAYER COMPOSITE OPACITY block. Numeric value stored as a string.

label_max_scale.title: Label max scale denominator
label_max_scale.description: Maximum scale denominator at which labels are drawn; labels stop appearing when zoomed out beyond this scale. Maps to MapServer LAYER LABELMAXSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

label_min_scale.title: Label min scale denominator
label_min_scale.description: Minimum scale denominator at which labels are drawn; labels stop appearing when zoomed in closer than this scale. Maps to MapServer LAYER LABELMINSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

cluster.title: Clustering distance
cluster.description: Point clustering MAXDISTANCE (layer SIZEUNITS, usually pixels) for an elliptical MapServer CLUSTER block (REGION "ellipse"). Empty disables clustering. Numeric value stored as a string.

meta_tiles.title: Meta tiles
meta_tiles.description: Legacy flag that used to toggle metatiling for the tile cache. Metatiling is now effectively controlled by meta_size (any value greater than 1 enables it); this key is kept for backward compatibility.

meta_size.title: Meta tile size
meta_size.description: Number of tile columns/rows fetched per WMS request when building the tile cache (mapcache METATILE size x size). Defaults to 3 when empty. Numeric value stored as a string.

meta_buffer.title: Meta buffer size (px)
meta_buffer.description: Buffer, in pixels, drawn around each (meta)tile and cropped off afterwards to prevent edge artifacts (mapcache METABUFFER). Numeric value stored as a string.

ttl.title: Time to live (TTL)

lock.description: Locks the tile cache so it cannot be cleared/busted via the cache-clear endpoints.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Comma-separated list of additional schema-qualified layer names merged into the WMS GetMap LAYERS request when building tiles for this layer, so several layers render into one cached tile.

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: Raster band selection passed as MapServer PROCESSING "BANDS=..."; one band is treated as greyscale, three as RGB, four as RGBA. Comma-separated band indices.

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Tile cache backend used by mapcache for this layer's tileset. Defaults to the site-wide mapcache type when empty.

s3_tile_set.title: S3 tile set name
s3_tile_set.description: Overrides the tile-set path segment used when cache is 's3'. Defaults to the layer name when empty.

label_no_clip.title: No clipping of labels
label_no_clip.description: Skips clipping of shapes when determining label anchor points (MapServer PROCESSING "LABEL_NO_CLIP=True"), avoiding label position jitter and duplicate labels across tiled requests.

polyline_no_clip.title: No clipping of polylines
polyline_no_clip.description: Skips clipping of shapes when rendering styled (dashed/symbolised) lines (MapServer PROCESSING "POLYLINE_NO_CLIP=True"), avoiding style discontinuities and edge effects across tiled requests.

angle.title: Angle

opacity.title: Opacity

linecap.title: Line cap
linecap.description: Line cap style used for line ends. Maps to STYLE LINECAP. Defaults to round.

geomtransform.title: Geomtransform

minsize.title: Min size

maxsize.title: Max size

offsetx.title: Offset X
offsetx.description: Horizontal geometry offset in layer SIZEUNITS (usually pixels); may reference a [column]. Maps to the X component of STYLE OFFSET. Numeric value stored as a string.

offsety.title: Offset Y
offsety.description: Vertical geometry offset in layer SIZEUNITS (usually pixels); may reference a [column]. Maps to the Y component of STYLE OFFSET. Numeric value stored as a string.

polaroffsetr.title: Polar offset radius
polaroffsetr.description: Radius/distance component of a polar-coordinate offset. Maps to the radius component of STYLE POLAROFFSET. Numeric value stored as a string.

polaroffsetd.title: Polar offset angle

maxscaledenom.title: Max scale denominator
maxscaledenom.description: Maximum scale denominator at which this label is drawn. Maps to MapServer LABEL MAXSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

position.title: Position

size.title: Size

color.title: Color

outlinecolor.title: Outline color

backgroundcolor.title: Background

offsety.title: Offset Y

font.title: Font

fontweight.title: Font weight

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: MapServer LABEL-level EXPRESSION; when set, this label entry is only rendered for features matching the expression.

maxsize.title: Max size
maxsize.description: Maximum font size, in pixels, used when scaling text. Maps to MapServer LABEL MAXSIZE. Defaults to 256. Numeric value stored as a string.

minfeaturesize.title: Min feature size
minfeaturesize.description: Minimum size, in pixels, a feature must have to be labeled (line length for lines, smallest bounding-box dimension for polygons); the keyword 'auto' labels only features larger than their own rendered label. Maps to MapServer LABEL MINFEATURESIZE.

minscaledenom.title: Min scale denominator
minscaledenom.description: Minimum scale denominator at which this class is drawn. Maps to MapServer CLASS MINSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

maxscaledenom.title: Max scale denominator
maxscaledenom.description: Maximum scale denominator at which this class is drawn. Maps to MapServer CLASS MAXSCALEDENOM. Numeric value stored as a string.

leader.title: Leader: on
leader.description: Enables a MapServer LEADER block that connects a label to its feature with a line when the label must be offset from its anchor.

leader_gridstep.title: Leader: gridstep
leader_gridstep.description: Grid step used to search for a valid label position around the feature. Maps to LEADER GRIDSTEP. Defaults to 5 when leader is on and this is empty. Numeric value stored as a string.

leader_maxdistance.title: Leader: maxdistance
leader_maxdistance.description: Maximum distance, in pixels, the label may be moved from the feature via the leader line. Maps to LEADER MAXDISTANCE. Defaults to 30 when leader is on and this is empty. Numeric value stored as a string.

leader_color.title: Leader: color
leader_color.description: Color of the leader line. Maps to the LEADER STYLE COLOR. Defaults to black when leader is on and this is empty.

tools.name: getSeedJobs
tools.description: The caller's seed jobs, newest first, without the log. A super-user sees every job of the database.

status.description: Keep only jobs in this status. An unknown status is not an error: it simply matches nothing and answers an empty array.

tileset.description: Keep only jobs for this tileset. Matched exactly; an unknown tileset answers an empty array.

tools.name: postSeedJob
tools.description: Queue one seed job (object) or several (array of objects). Asynchronous: answers 202 and a worker runs it. Requires write/owner on the tileset's relation. Every job in the list is validated and authorized before any of them is queued.

oneOf.description: The POST request body to queue a seed job. tileset, grid, zoom_start and zoom_end are required and, unlike their SeedJob response counterparts, never null here. Every other SeedJob property is server-owned and ignored (in fact rejected) on input.

grid.description: One of the grids that tileset declares in the database's tile cache configuration (GC2 generates a grid called g20 for every tileset). Any other name is 400 UNKNOWN_GRID, and the message lists the grids the tileset does have.

zoom_start.description: First zoom level to seed. Must be >= 0 and <= zoom_end.

zoom_end.description: Last zoom level to seed. Must be within the grid's own zoom levels.

extent_layer.description: Optional relation whose features bound the seeded area. It must exist and the caller must have read privilege on it.

threads.description: How many seeding threads mapcache_seed runs (-n). 1 to tileseeder.maxThreads, which defaults to 4; a higher value is refused with 400 INVALID_REQUEST naming the limit, not clamped to it. Defaults to 1.
